tools.name: send_project_brief_to_pulore
tools.description: Use this only when the person has explicitly asked to contact Pulore or send Pulore their project. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "audit_website_speed" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_website_speed, get_pulore_booking_link · Private data: audit_website_speed, find_pulore_case_studies, send_project_brief_to_pulore · Public sink: audit_website_speed, send_project_brief_to_pulore, get_pulore_booking_link · Destructive: find_pulore_case_studies.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_website_speed, get_pulore_booking_link · Private data: audit_website_speed, find_pulore_case_studies, send_project_brief_to_pulore · Public sink: audit_website_speed, send_project_brief_to_pulore, get_pulore_booking_link · Destructive: find_pulore_case_studies

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
